raw_segments.text: In fact, the artist's design seemed this—a final theory of my own, partly based upon
the aggregated opinions of many aged persons with whom I conversed upon the subject.
The picture represents a Cape Horner in a great hurricane, the half-foundered ship weltering
there with its three dismantled masts alone visible, and an exasperated whale, purposing
